title: Greedy word wrap
prompt: Implement wrap(text, width) in wrap.js. Paragraphs are separated by one or more blank lines; wrap each separately and join them with one blank line. Inside a paragraph, any whitespace between words (single line breaks included) counts as one space. Fill each line greedily with as many words as fit in width characters. A word longer than width starts on a new line and is cut into pieces of width characters; words after its last piece may continue on that line. Lines have no leading or trailing spaces. Empty or blank text returns ''. width below 1 throws a RangeError. Do not change test.js.
